name: P-008 native expired pairing guidance renders without clipping
summary: The maintained Mac simulator runner passed 60 unit tests, five UI smoke tests and the selected expired-code/fresh-pairing journey with zero failures or skips. Native rendered-bounds assertions passed for onboarding instructions and expired-code guidance, and the retry button was hittable. Review of the actual recovery PNG confirmed both complete messages. All 277 declared artifacts matched retained archive hashes and sizes. The disposable fixture, private inputs and Mac lease were cleaned up.

assertions.evidence: ui-smoke-summary.json records five passed, zero failed and zero skipped. The fresh-launch test includes the full instruction text bounds assertion.

paired-ui-summary.json records one passed, zero failed and zero skipped. The test measures full instruction and error text bounds, checks Try again is hittable, verifies an ordinary unpaired relaunch, then fresh pairing and Keychain relaunch.

Reviewed retained/paired-ui-attachments/D6EB7EDC-AF02-4384-9441-814E463F833C.png: all instructions through 'QR code shown.' and all error guidance through 'desktop.' render visibly. Historical EE283E55-0145-4D29-9551-3CB49FF50447.png clipped both messages.

assertions.id: native unit suite and artifact custody
assertions.evidence: unit-1-summary.json records 60 passed, zero failed and zero skipped. local-artifact-verification.json checked all 277 declared artifacts directly from native-artifacts.tar.gz with no hash or size mismatches.

Fixture task completed with exit zero. runtime.json records processCleanupVerified, cloudCleanupVerified and cleanupVerified true. local-cleanup-verification.json confirms both ports closed, fixture HOME absent and both local input files absent. Guest private directory was absent and the exclusive Mac lease release succeeded.

sourceIdentityNote: Clean canonical source and the dirty guest candidate had identical measured content fingerprints. Guest Git metadata remained at its earlier snapshot; this is simulator regression proof, not clean signed-release admission.
rootCause: The unscrollable root VStack compressed multiline Text when the error card was present. PairView now uses a ScrollView and fixed vertical text sizing. Existence-only accessibility checks had retained complete labels despite visible truncation; conventional XCTest rendered-bounds checks now cover that gap.

retainedEvidence.pathBase: Operating account home directory; retained evidence is outside the staging checkout.

disclosedGaps: This proof covers the reported clipping case on iPhone 16 Pro with iOS 18.6 simulator; it is not a universal device or Dynamic Type visual census.
Broader P-008 offline/isolation and accepted cloud target acceptance remain open.
No rubric acceptance grade, signed-release admission, App Store, TestFlight or final shipment claim is made.
